concerns.text: The Execution Metric entity defined in `data-model.md` includes fields `timestamp` and `timeout_flag`, but the CSV schema described in the plan (`query_id,source_type,complexity_level,latency_ms,translation_error,success_flag,synthetic_flag,throttling_mode`) omits both. This violates the Plan ↔ Data‑Model consistency requirement.

The `query_instance.schema.yaml` contract exists, yet the plan never states that `generation_log.json` will be validated against this schema. Every contract must be exercised by at least one plan step.

Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) is claimed as PASS, but the plan does not explicitly link statistical results (`anova_results.json`, `sensitivity_analysis.json`) to a single source of truth file. Adding a note that these JSON files are the SSoT for statistical outputs would close the gap.
